releaseGate.foundationEvidence: The first integrated Cyberpunk 2077 2.31 milestone proved exact compile, package assembly, clean installation, official REDmod recognition of Biology, and real five-stage REDmod deployment.
releaseGate.reason: The launcher activation and hard-uninstall implementations are now integrated in source, but public release remains gated on the new combined exact build and attended launcher ON/OFF, hard-uninstall, body-runtime, Biology-shell, E3-presentation, overlap/precedence, broader gameplay/save/quest/performance acceptance, and final release audit.

components.notes: Biology-owned REDmod identity and activation marker plus accepted project-original runtime. Tests, reports, staging, local reference mods and source-only tooling stay out of player artifacts.

Directly required by accepted Biology-owned additive/wrapper runtime seams. It may still load while launcher mods are OFF, so it is never activation authority; player uninstall preserves this generic/shared dependency.

Biology owns no RED4ext plugin. Retained only as transitive plumbing for the current ArchiveXL/Mod Settings chain. It may remain loaded when REDmod is disabled, so #44's integrated launcher marker is the Biology activation boundary; player uninstall preserves the generic framework.

No direct Biology resource consumer. Retained only because the current Mod Settings adapter depends on it; it is preserved by player uninstall and should be removed from future Biology releases when no accepted consumer remains.

Current provider-neutral persistent adapter for Enable Biology and E3-inspired HUD + nameplates. Saved enabled=true cannot override launcher OFF. It is preserved by player uninstall and has no entitlement to remain once a smaller accepted provider/boundary replaces it.
No current Biology production source/data path requires TweakXL.
Current Biology UI uses native/REDscript routes and has no Codeware dependency.
Current Biology runtime adds no custom input binding requiring Input Loader.
Historical research/provenance may remain in the repository, but executing Dark Future content is forbidden from Biology candidates.

Issue #40 uses the local-only Project E3 reference and durable component inventory to guide Biology-owned presentation. Project E3 scripts, archives and tweaks remain forbidden from player runtime artifacts.
No Cyberpunk executable, stock archive, final.redscripts, save or user settings may enter a Biology artifact. Installed final.redscripts may be read only as an exact-compile base.

artifactRequirements: Game-root-relative paths only for runtime payload.
The official first-party REDmod identity is mods/Biology and it owns the inert launcher activation marker.
The integrated artifact contains Biology project-original runtime plus pinned redscript and only the temporary RED4ext/ArchiveXL/Mod Settings chain still justified by the current preference provider.
Every installed file is represented by exact owner/component/route/uninstall-policy/SHA-256 metadata; shared framework roots are never recursively Biology-owned.
One hashed Uninstall Biology.exe is built into the same release artifact and consumes the matching schema-2 ownership receipt.
Player uninstall preserves generic/shared dependencies, saves and Biology preferences by default and refuses changed or ambiguous Biology-owned file deletion.
INSTALL.txt documents the launcher ON/OFF contract, supported REDmod/Steam activation, normal launch target, and remaining attended gates.
BIOLOGY-VERSION.txt, provenance, owner manifest and SHA-256 checksums identify the exact candidate.
Required licenses and third-party notices for every bundled generic dependency are included without development-only files.
Blocked or not-required components cause artifact construction to fail closed rather than silently expanding the dependency stack.
Public release remains gated until direct-game and attended acceptance is recorded; successful CI/exact compilation is not live acceptance.
